body:
Please consider the 1/2 formulation of WOWII Conjecture360 (18 February 2009) with Jonas J. Gebendorfer, *Center distance and total domination in trees: a counterexample to Graffiti.pc Conjecture 360*.

The assertion for a tree T of order n>2 is gamma_t(T) >= c(T[S union L]) + dist_avg(C,V)/2, where L is the leaf set, S=N(L), C is the full eccentricity-center set, and dist_avg averages strictly positive ordered distances, with denominator |C|(n-1).

**Source distinction.** The older frozen HTML has a blank multiplier before dist_avg; the public HTML-row dataset explicitly contains 1/2, as does the Kuber transcription. This intake targets that explicit 1/2 version and preserves the discrepancy. It does not silently fill a missing glyph or claim that every archival copy is identical.

**Witness and exact calculation.** Start with path 0-1-...-9, add leaves10 at3 and11 at6, and add29 leaves12,...,40 at1. This tree has n=41. D={1,2,3,6,7,8} is total dominating. The six vertices {0,10,11,9,1,8} have pairwise disjoint nonempty open neighborhoods, so every total dominating set has at least6 vertices. Thus gamma_t=6. The centers are4 and5; T[S union L] has4 components. Exact positive center-distance average is321/80, giving RHS=4+321/160=6+1/160 >6. The paper gives the full family, with equality at28 added leaves and violation for every number at least29.

Fresh verification reconstructs the graph, computes all distances and the center, checks both certificates and compares a separate exact tree optimizer. No floating-point comparison is used.

Source: [DeLaViña's WOWII archive](https://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/open.html), with linked definitions, and the preserved [public HTML-row dataset](https://gitlab.com/ai-village-agents/village/graffiti-verification/-/blob/main/data/wow2_rows_html.json). Historical O and secondary transcriptions are not a current curator decision. No worldwide first-priority or independent external review is claimed.

The attachment contains the full six manuscripts by Jonas J. Gebendorfer (13 October 2026), a newly reconstructed standard-library verifier, its executed output, preserved source records and a SHA256 manifest. Run `python3 audit_new_manuscripts.py`. This is a fresh diagnostic, not a claim to have recovered or rerun the papers' originally described supplements. Finite checks are not proof premises. OpenAI Codex assisted with source comparison, proof reading, reconstruction and submission under the author's direction.

[Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33421512/Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip)

14 October 2026: the complete Lean certificate for the explicitly transcribed half-average version is now available, and the exact statement is submitted in #7321.

Pinned [proof](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/a95d2f088ec6384d1739aaa115b750ba61b874f8/Proofs/WOWII360Proof.lean), [independent exact-statement/axiom audit](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/a95d2f088ec6384d1739aaa115b750ba61b874f8/Proofs/WOWII360Audit.lean), and [reproduction instructions](https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/blob/a95d2f088ec6384d1739aaa115b750ba61b874f8/Proofs/README-WOWII360.md).

The kernel proves genuine shortest-path distances, the tree property, centers {4,5}, positive center average 321/80, at least four induced leaf/support components, and a six-element total dominating set. These sufficient inequalities refute the universal assertion. Both files compile without warnings; all ten audited declarations use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The upstream module passes lake --wfail build.

The older frozen HTML's blank multiplier remains explicitly distinguished from the 1/2 transcription. No exact total-domination optimum, exact component count, infinite-family formalization or minimum-order claim is made by this certificate. This is author-workflow verification, with maintainer source/statement review pending.

OpenAI Codex assisted under Jonas J. Gebendorfer's direction.

title: WOWII 360: a 41-vertex counterexample to the half-average center-distance bound
